cases: Pre-cast threshold snapshot is immutable during triggered ability resolution: first noncreature cast cannot gain Abaddon cascade from Kessig's damage on that same cast
Subsequent spells from hand can gain Abaddon cascade after Kessig resolves; spells cast from exile never gain it
Birgi red-mana trigger cannot pay for the spell that triggered it, but its mana can pay for later spells
Heartless and Tree tap abilities require being controlled since start of the turn absent haste
Heartless damage trigger persists on stack after Heartless removal while Tree's exchange fails without its source on battlefield
Bituminous Blast printed cascade exists even if Abaddon absent; two cascade instances possible when qualifying hand cast with Abaddon present
Cascade finds a strictly lower mana value nonland card; exiled casts resolve using actual cast-from-exile rules and trigger Kessig/Birgi
Mana payment checks colored requirements, creature target constraints and command-zone tax
Solphim and Bloodletter require presence on resolution; controller damage is not multiplied by Solphim
Damage prevention and game-ending state stop further spell actions; next-turn reset clears threshold and floating mana
Unimplemented real-card effects and unsupported stack actions fail closed rather than silently assuming value

scenarios.description: Two one-mana test noncreature spells with Kessig; only second receives granted cascade after first ping resolves
Pay red for Boltwave; resolve Birgi mana trigger then use that red for later Boltwave
Resolve activated Heartless ability after removing its source
Resolve activated Tree ability after removing its source
Bituminous Blast from hand with current threshold at least five and a legal creature target
Bituminous Blast from hand without Abaddon, legal creature target
Cascade into a lower-mv synthetic noncreature spell from exile and apply noncreature cast triggers

limits: Purposefully tiny deterministic effect interpreter, not comprehensive Comprehensive Rules engine
No opponent AI, multiplayer priorities, responses frequencies, library/mulligan distributions, card draw/selection, tutor policies, or Game Changer bracket probabilities
Only specifically supported card effects; test-only synthetic spells must not enter real approved decks
Default trigger stack order deterministic, not an optimal priority/trigger-order search
No actual comparative deck win rate, no complete M6 Phase B, no Pass C, I/J certificates or candidate improvement proof
